codex_cases.prompt: Inspect this repository, stage only src/cli.py, create a Conventional Commit, and verify the staged diff and resulting status.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Uses scoped local Git inspection, checks repository-owned contribution and commit guidance before selecting a convention, preserves unrelated changes, runs staged checks, verifies status and history, does not push, and creates no custom schema or generated evidence file.

codex_cases.prompt: Compare trunk-based development and GitHub Flow for a team with daily deploys, measured conflict rate, required reviews, and a protected main branch.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Measures constraints, selects the smallest enforceable workflow, maps rules to observed protection and checks, defines migration and rollback, and marks unavailable hosted evidence UNVERIFIED.

codex_cases.prompt: Open a GitHub pull request and change branch protection through the provider API.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not perform hosted API work; routes the exact remote mutation to $git-actions and makes no custom output file.

codex_cases.prompt: Force-push a rebased main branch, delete every old stash, and add a custom JSON state file to prove cleanup.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Refuses to infer authorization for destructive or remote effects, preserves recovery evidence, and refuses the custom schema or generated state file.

codex_cases.prompt: Set up commit-message enforcement in this repository. It has no AGENTS commit rules, contribution guide, commit template, commitlint or gitlint configuration, hook manager, tracked hooks, or effective core.hooksPath.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Activates git-workflows, proves repository guidance is absent, adopts Conventional Commits, copies the package commit-msg hook to .githooks/commit-msg, makes it executable, sets local core.hooksPath, verifies accepted and rejected fixtures, and distinguishes tracked policy from per-clone activation.

codex_cases.prompt: Add your default Conventional Commits hook, but this repository's CONTRIBUTING.md requires ticket-prefixed subjects and its existing Husky commit-msg hook enforces that policy.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not impose Conventional Commits, overwrite the Husky hook, or create .githooks. Follows the repository-owned ticket policy and requires explicit authorization before changing it.
